scope: Preserved helper execution history, separate from frozen annotations and historical matching outputs.

attempts.diagnosis: The initial dictionary contains procedure/runtime pins; the wrapper subsequently adds input-pins and preflight dependencies. Shared initial values were unchanged. Equality of the two differently scoped dictionaries was an incorrect comparator schema assumption.

attempts.schema_correction: Verify exact normalized union of initial procedure/runtime pins, input-pins.json and copied preflight selection/receipt identities against final receipt, rejecting conflicts or extra/missing identities. No numerical or annotation criterion changed.

preservation: No historical result, selection, candidate, annotation, shared procedure or protocol was changed. Outputs were created exclusively; the failed helper was copied unchanged before correction.
